senses.gloss:
m. (-तः)
1 A Saugata, a heretic, an atheist.
2 A Bauddha.
E.
सुगत the supposed teacher of these doctrines, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A Bauddha mendicant.
2 The mendicant Brahman.
3 Doubt, unbelief, scepticism.
4 An atheist, an unbeliever.
E.
सुगत the founder of the sect, ठक् aff.

n. (-न्धं)
1 A fragrant grass: see कत्तृण.
2 Fragrance.
E.
सुगन्ध fragrant, अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Fragrant, odorous.
n. (-कं)
1 The white water-lily, (Nymphæa lotus.)
2 A fragrant grass: see कत्तृण.
3 A ruby.
m. (-कः)
1 Sulphur.
2 A dealer in perfumes.
E.
सु pleasant, गन्ध smell, and ठक् added.

n. (-न्ध्यं)
Odour, fragrance.
E.
सुगन्ध, and ष्यञ् aff.
